decks.notes: The deck focuses on control and utilizes a variety of colors to achieve its objectives. It includes cards like Force of Negation, Swords to Plowshares, Force of Will, and Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt opponents' strategies and maintain board control. The deck also features cards like Sylvan Library, Brainstorm, and Ponder to ensure consistent card draw and selection. Additionally, the deck includes powerful threats such as Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes to pressure opponents. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds an extra element of value and flexibility to the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board control and disrupt your opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong aggressive stance. By utilizing powerful artifacts like Chalice of the Void and fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox, you can quickly deploy threats like Archon of Emeria and Solitude. The deck also has ways to protect your creatures and generate value with cards like Karakas and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Overall, the deck aims to dominate the battlefield early on and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The key concept of this control deck is to leverage powerful blue and white control spells, along with versatile planeswalkers like Narset and Teferi, to disrupt the opponent's game plan and control the battlefield. The deck focuses on card advantage, disruption, and control elements like counterspells and removal to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victory. Key cards like Narset, Prismatic Ending, and Force of Will help maintain control of the game while presenting threats like Shark Typhoon to close out the game. The deck aims to outvalue opponents and stay ahead in card advantage throughout the game.

The main concept of this Mystic Forge combo deck is to generate infinite mana by untapping artifacts with cards like Voltaic Key and Manifold Key, and then utilizing Mystic Forge and Karn, the Great Creator to cast an endless stream of spells from the top of the library, eventually winning the game with a Walking Ballista or another win condition. Defense Grid provides protection from opponent's interaction, while Echo of Eons allows for large hand refills. With a focus on mana acceleration and artifact synergy, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent.

The main idea of this deck is to cast Mystic Forge and use it with cards like Basalt Monolith and Mesmeric Orb to generate card advantage and eventually find a win condition like Walking Ballista. Defense Grid is included to protect key combo pieces, while Karn, the Great Creator can fetch artifacts from the sideboard. The deck aims to accelerate mana with cards like Lotus Petal and Grim Monolith, allowing for explosive plays. The deck is designed to efficiently combo off and win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on assembling the Cephalid Breakfast combo, using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill through the library and put Narcomoeba into play. This allows for a quick win condition with Dread Return targeting Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck also includes various control elements like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo. The inclusion of Urza's Saga helps to find key pieces of the combo, making the deck efficient and consistent in executing its game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to quickly generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining aggressive creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch with powerful artifact cards like Mox Opal and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a stream of threats while also controlling the board with cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Thought Monitor allows for consistent card draw, ensuring the deck maintains its aggressive pace throughout the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing a wide range of control elements, including counterspells, removal, and card draw, to manipulate the board state and outvalue the opponent. The deck also leverages the power of the Yorion companion to generate additional value from entering the battlefield effects, creating a more grindy and controlling playstyle. With a mix of powerful creatures like Uro and Ice-Fang Coatl, along with versatile spells like Green Sun's Zenith and Swords to Plowshares, this deck aims to establish board control and dominate the late game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently use Show and Tell to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, Griselbrand, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. By combining this with reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead, the deck can overwhelm opponents with high-impact threats ahead of schedule. Additionally, disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will are included to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to win through explosive plays and overwhelming board presence.

This deck aims to play aggressively by utilizing the powerful Death's Shadow creature alongside disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will. The deck's strategy revolves around dealing damage to itself in order to reduce Death's Shadow's casting cost and make it a massive threat on the board. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of efficient removal spells, card draw, and counterspells to control the game and protect its key threats. The deck excels in applying early pressure and leveraging Death's Shadow's strength to close out games quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Mishra's Bauble, and then bring them back into play with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck focuses on using cards like Grief and Archon of Cruelty to disrupt your opponent's game plan while also putting pressure on them with Baleful Strix and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and disruption spells, ultimately securing a victory through a powerful combo strategy.

This Legacy Aggro - Maverick deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while developing a strong board presence with efficient creatures like Knight of the Reliquary and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. The deck utilizes green mana acceleration with Noble Hierarch and Green Sun's Zenith to ramp into powerful threats like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Questing Beast. The inclusion of hate cards like Collector Ouphe and Spirit of the Labyrinth helps to disrupt opponent strategies, while the mana base provides versatility and consistency through access to various colors and utility lands.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex to slow down the opponent, while using cards like Swords to Plowshares and Solitude to deal with threats. It also utilizes cards like Urza's Saga and Ancient Tomb for mana acceleration, allowing for quick deployment of powerful creatures like Timeless Dragon. The deck aims to maintain control of the board and apply pressure with its creatures, using cards like Esper Sentinel to keep the opponent from advancing their game plan.

The main focus of this BUG Midrange deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while efficiently deploying threats and controlling the board. By using a combination of hand disruption spells, removal, counterspells, and powerful creatures like Uro, Grief, and Baleful Strix, the deck aims to keep the opponent off balance while generating value and pushing towards a win. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Reanimate and Dauthi Voidwalker to further leverage its resources and keep up pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing Cascade mechanics to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures like Shardless Agent and Crashing Footfalls. The deck aims to disrupt opponents with counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation while maintaining a fast tempo with cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Violent Outburst. Additionally, the inclusion of Murktide Regent provides a powerful finisher to seal the game. This strategy allows the deck to continuously apply pressure and force opponents to react, ultimately leading to victory through an aggressive and explosive playstyle.

This deck focuses on quickly playing threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Daze. It aims to control the board and tempo of the game through efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, while also digging for answers with Ponder and Brainstorm. The deck's aggressive nature is supported by its mana base and card draw, allowing it to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.
